high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque scene viewed through an arched window with a wooden frame. The window is divided into two sections: the upper part features a circular window, while the lower part consists of a rectangular section. Inside the room, there are two wicker chairs positioned near the window, suggesting a cozy and inviting space. A large, beige patio umbrella stands prominently in the foreground, partially open and leaning against a pole. The umbrella has a label that reads "WWW," which could be a brand or a decorative element.
